HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-12 ~01:20 PST (workstream C2, third pass).
- graceless-thievish-olm CLOSED. Change 3358 (b603c4544e8) moves the Bedrock cache-ratio and unit-cost alarms into Terraform on the 5.5 ids (infra/terraform/monitoring_bedrock_cost.tf, keyed by a locals map). It was applied through scripts/terraform_prod.py (4 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed; a re-plan shows no changes), and the 4 hand-made 4.x alarms are deleted. All 4 new alarms are OK and evaluating live 5.5 series (get-metric-data shows non-empty hourly data for both ModelIds). The classifier did not block this apply.
- juiced-anarthrous-bird CLOSED. Change 3363 (76ab41f2af9): the autodeploy no-op tick refreshes the live MCP code workspace in place via `mcp-entrypoint.sh --refresh-code`, so a non-MCP commit reaches it without a container restart (observed live at 01:05 PST). MCP closes now verify against current main without `ref=`.
- All 5.5 Bedrock alarms are now Terraform-managed. Nothing in production alarms on the 4.x ids.
